en.title: Income Tax for Salaried People — 2026–27
en.directAnswer: For salaried people, income tax depends on the current tax-year rules, taxable salary components, exemptions, rebates, other income, tax already deducted and filing obligations. Do not use last year’s tax thresholds. This page must be rebuilt each tax year from the Income Tax Act, Finance Act and current NBR notices.

atAGlance.whoFor: A salaried person wants to know the current tax-year process.

en.lawMeaning:
Every numeric threshold, slab, minimum tax and rebate must have a current NBR citation in the published version.

This page gives a general route. A person’s exact rights can change because of facts, documents, deadlines, legal status, court orders or later amendments.
steps: Identify exempt or specially treated amounts under current law.
Subtract tax already paid or withheld.
Check whether a return is required.
evidence: Relevant official notices, receipts, and correspondence
en.simpleExample: A worker earning the same monthly salary as a friend may still have a different final tax because benefits, investments, other income and tax already deducted can differ.
commonMistakes: assuming no tax means no return..
en.specialistTrigger: Large income; foreign income; stock/business income; disputed assessment; tax notice.
